title: No instants or clock changes in the date engine: the domain's time runs on @internationalized/date
kit: The kit's date engine has calendar dates and wall times, but no instant type, no zone-aware arithmetic across a clock change and no way to resolve a wall time in a gap or an overlap.
workaround: src/lib/domain/time.ts implements the instant, zone and clock-change functions on @internationalized/date behind the interface the domain needs; its tests stay when the implementation moves onto the kit.
